text:
Aisha Patel: heads-up: noticed buttons in compact density are wrapping differently in the console header on narrow viewports. also toasts are overlapping the primary action on small screens. attaching a quick gif: https://figma.com/file/xYz (mock)
Tom Reynolds: can you paste the css tokens you used for compact? might be an accidental min-width change or the token stepping for spacing-xs
Aisha Patel: compact uses tokens: --space-xxs:4px, --space-xs:8px, --btn-padding-x:10px, --btn-min-width:64px. gif shows primary button being pushed under the right-side toasts when multiple toasts stack.
Maya Chen: that stack overlap is familiar — we had a previous fix where toasts used transform for enter/exit which caused overflow issues with fixed headers. Maybe z-index + translateZ trick? but needs keyboard focus check too.
Jorge Alvarez: +1 on checking z-index. also: what happens for keyboard users when toast covers a button that gets focus? should be announced or not focusable? accessibility-wise we don't want focus to land under a transient overlay.
Tom Reynolds: quick proposal: increase --btn-min-width to 72px for compact only, and make toasts use a top offset of 72px when header present. code:
```
.toast {
  top: var(--header-height);
  transform: translateY(0);
  z-index: var(--z-toast, 800);
}
.button--compact { min-width: 72px; padding: 6px 10px; }
```
Aisha Patel: that helps visual density but might break some table action buttons that rely on 64px. we have many small icon-only buttons in tables.
Maya Chen: for icon-only buttons in tables, keep min-width 40px and treat them as separate variant: `.button--icon` — don't lump with primary compact global token.
Jorge Alvarez: also let's not forget focus ring: keyboard focus should never be occluded by a toast. If a toast would overlap a focused element, we should auto-scroll or shift toast stack. simple rule: if focusedEl.getBoundingClientRect().top < toastBottom then move toasts down.
design-ci-bot: accessibility-scan: failed for thread 1799987654 — issue: "toast overlaps interactive element when viewport-height < 480px". See /tests/accessibility/toasts/stacking
Tom Reynolds: thanks bot. action items: (1) Aisha to prototype compact min-width delta + icon-only variant, (2) Maya to spec keyboard behavior and toast shift rule, (3) Jorge to run regression on tables. I'll open a PR with the token change and an opt-in flag for compact density to avoid surprising changes.
Aisha Patel: sounds good. I'll mock both options in Figma and share link by EOD. :sparkles:
Maya Chen: I'll draft the a11y proposal and include a short playbook for QA (keyboard nav + screen reader expectations).
Jorge Alvarez: will run the table suite and report any broken snapshots. ping me when PR is ready.
Tom Reynolds: cheers — if no objections I'll land the token bump behind a feature flag first. :+1:
